post_title: PERM restart due to promotion - any way around this?
concerns_or_questions_summary: Company is restarting the PERM process (I-140 not yet filed) because the user was promoted from Engineer I to Engineer II despite minimal duty/pay change. H-1B extension was filed under Engineer II, so the employer will not file the I-140 under the old title. Asking whether there is any workaround to avoid the 2+ year PERM restart given the visa timeline.
